baseline: H0: existing 60-observation residual momentum, EWMA alpha=0.25
B00: prior-only 250-observation new-high Long / new-low Short, EWMA alpha=0.25

trials.description: The 250-observation channel-position score alone with common EWMA alpha=0.25

feature_definitions.channel_position_250: 2*(Close(t-1)-min(Low(t-251:t-2)))/(max(High(t-251:t-2))-min(Low(t-251:t-2)))-1; prior 250 observations exclude t-1, High maps to +1, Low to -1, out-of-range values are not clipped.
feature_definitions.missing_history: Neutral score 0 when a full 250-observation range or positive range width is unavailable.
feature_definitions.price_basis: Raw OHLC converted to a causal common share unit by cumulative observed AdjustmentFactor events; no retrospectively adjusted OHLC levels.

model: No fitted predictor. Use channel_position_250 as the sole daily cross-sectional score, then apply common EWMA alpha=0.25.

selection_rule.primary: Descriptive Train-only comparison; no selection because all periods are known.
